long_biography.plain_text:
Mountain Manor placed Charles Nabit at the centre of a new addiction-treatment project in Maryland. His father co-owned part of the site's real estate, while Nabit led the healthcare company and carried its operating responsibility. The facility became part of a wider career developing and overseeing treatment, rehabilitation, home-care and pharmacy businesses.

Nabit brought legal and property experience to that expansion. After corporate and real-estate work at Venable, he became Westport Group's managing partner and adopted a delegation model built around hiring specialists and giving them authority. He later led Developmental Disability Management Services for more than three decades. His current investment work combines marketable securities and property with advice to healthcare-software companies.
